prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity mobile app concept comp, portrait phone screen
Primary request: Create a polished native mobile UI mockup for the ACNH Diary mobile control system, screen 3 of 3: Encyclopedia and Catalog collection controls. Korean ACNH player audience, iOS-first with future Android adaptation. Structure: native safe-area header titled 도감, segmented switch for 도감 / 카탈로그, compact applied-filter summary, scrollable grid/list of collectible item cards. Each item card should show a large official-game-like creature/item icon thumbnail, Korean item name, availability or category chip, and large 48dp icon-first toggles for 잡음, 기증, 보유. Use museum building icon for donated, check/net icon for caught, leaf/bag icon for owned. Include a filter bottom sheet preview with large icon category tiles: 곤충, 물고기, 해산물, 화석, 미술품, 가구, 옷, 음악. Text should be reduced and Korean-first; no long explanations. Color system: warm island paper base, museum blue for donated/reference, leaf green for collected, catalog amber for owned, coral for attention/error, neutral dark ink; dark-mode capable feeling through clear semantic contrast. Make it feel like a NookPhone Critterpedia/catalog tool, not a generic pastel dashboard. High-fidelity phone screenshot, 390x844 logical portrait, realistic native UI spacing, large tap targets, no web browser chrome, no watermark, no Nintendo logo.
